meta.rule: abstract names semaglutide and reports the bundle adverse event as an outcome; see module docstring

NAION.query: TITLE_ABS:(semaglutide OR Wegovy OR Ozempic OR Rybelsus) AND TITLE_ABS:(NAION OR "ischemic optic neuropathy" OR "ischaemic optic neuropathy") AND FIRST_PDATE:[2021-01-01 TO 2026-11-23] AND SRC:MED AND HAS_ABSTRACT:y

GASTROPARESIS.query: TITLE_ABS:(semaglutide OR Wegovy OR Ozempic OR Rybelsus) AND TITLE_ABS:(gastroparesis OR "gastric paralysis" OR "gastric emptying") AND FIRST_PDATE:[2021-01-01 TO 2026-11-23] AND SRC:MED AND HAS_ABSTRACT:y

PANCREATITIS.query: TITLE_ABS:(semaglutide OR Wegovy OR Ozempic OR Rybelsus) AND TITLE_ABS:(pancreatitis) AND FIRST_PDATE:[2021-01-01 TO 2026-11-23] AND SRC:MED AND HAS_ABSTRACT:y

SUICIDALITY.query: TITLE_ABS:(semaglutide OR Wegovy OR Ozempic OR Rybelsus) AND TITLE_ABS:(suicid*) AND FIRST_PDATE:[2021-01-01 TO 2026-11-23] AND SRC:MED AND HAS_ABSTRACT:y
